newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac to publish newspaper article Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to publish newspaper article Wednesday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will write an article to be published in 14 regional newspapers on Wednesday, the second anniversary of his election.
Chirac had been expected to intervene on Wednesday in a parliamentary election campaign where the centre-right coalition is ahead but losing ground to the opposition Socialist party in opinion polls.
The plans for the newspaper article were confirmed by Chirac's office.

It will be published in Ouest France, La Voix du Nord, Sud Ouest, La Depeche du Midi, Le Midi libre, Nice Matin, Le Provencal, Le Progres, Le Dauphine libere, L'Est republicain, Le Republicain Lorrain, Les Dernieres Nouvelles d'Alsace, La Nouvelle Republique du Centre ouest and La Montagne.
